isolation.statement: A fresh independent task reviewed only the locked v2.4 contracts, preregistered manifest, draft inventory, full local transcript chain, and exact validators; no legacy assessment, development example, annotation pass, score, or other debate was available.

findings.description: The draft selected Oppy's 00:20:31 scale-autonomy argument as his second constructive even though his 00:13:09 physical-state answer to the Mary case is an earlier load-bearing constructive act.

The draft used Huemer's 00:38:02 reply as the second first-quarter response, but Oppy's distinct 00:37:30 claim that organism-level physical states can bear representational content qualifies earlier.

The draft assigned probability, identity, and finite-history objections to CON-BRAIN-DEPENDENCE even when the selected acts contained no brain-dependence premise, and it lacked a con burden for the independent recurrence and identity bridge.

The draft excerpt ended while merely raising whether a recurring office counts as the same office, but its rationale attributed Huemer's later conclusion that office identity may be semantic while future personal identity is not verbal.

The draft labeled the 01:16:57 and 01:17:32 acts as third-quarter selections, although the exact interval after the fourth constructive through the last substantive act places the third-quarter boundary at 01:19:24.
The qualifying 00:59:42 con follow-up precedes the selected pro response, but the draft did not log that it was skipped to enforce the preregistered minimum of four total moves per side.

The draft's final response targeted whether infinite value destroys consequentialism, a downstream ethical issue rather than a load-bearing soul or survival component, while a later response directly addressed whether physical recurrence remains possible after heat death.
